name: @chrischall/therapyportal-mcp
description: MCP server for TherapyNotes client portals (TherapyPortal): upcoming appointments, paperwork, practice forms, balances, receipts and secure messages, plus document and receipt downloads.

scripts.bundle: esbuild src/index.ts --bundle --alias:zod/v4=./node_modules/zod/v4/index.cjs --define:process.env.FETCHPROXY_WS_PORT=undefined --define:process.env.WS_NO_BUFFER_UTIL='"1"' --define:process.env.WS_NO_UTF_8_VALIDATE='"1"' --platform=node --format=esm --banner:js='import { createRequire as __createRequire } from "module"; const require = __createRequire(import.meta.url);' --outfile=dist/bundle.js

author: chrischall
